title: Amazon S3 to AWS Step Functions with Amazon EventBridge Rule
description: How to create an Amazon EventBridge rule with Amazon S3 as the event source and AWS Step Functions as target.

introBox.headline: Integrating Step Functions and S3 with EventBridge
text: This sample project demonstrates invoking an AWS Step Functions state machine when an object is created in an Amazon S3 bucket.
When you upload an object to the S3 bucket,  an `Object Created` event is sent to EventBridge. Based on the EventBridge rule, the state machine is invoked.
This pattern deploys one Step Function state machine, one S3 bucket, one EventBridge rule.
